description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Notification under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) was passed by Parliament at its Public Session on 09.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of customs duties through a parliamentary resolution under the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new regulatory rates for imported goods, which falls under legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
